notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/yang-zj1026__navila-bench --backend fake; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by kind model, reviewed_by null); no hardware or simulator run is claimed. The card's entry symbol Go2MatterportVisionCfg was confirmed at isaaclab_exts/omni.isaac.vlnce/omni/isaac/vlnce/config/go2/go2_matterport_vision_cfg.py:163, where it is defined as a subclass of Go2MatterportBaseCfg. The registered task go2_matterport_vision is at isaaclab_exts/omni.isaac.vlnce/omni/isaac/vlnce/config/go2/__init__.py:20-28 with the external entry point omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv; the clone supplies the configuration only, so the driver names the card's configuration class as native and G7 reports MAYBE_ABSENT for the Gymnasium interface names because the environment base ManagerBasedRLEnvCfg is outside the clone. This package serves the go2 task; the card's second symbol, H1MatterportVisionCfg at h1_matterport_vision_cfg.py:350, is not implemented. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD mock path: mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the task needs Isaac Sim 4.1.0, Isaac Lab 1.1.0, a CUDA GPU, the Hugging Face R2R/Matterport assets and an environment configuration object passed to gym.make (README.md:55-82 and scripts/navila_eval.py:271); package code never imports or runs the clone, so the fake is the package's own pure Python interface stand-in (fake.py), not the upstream simulator, and the sim path was not run. NOT COVERED: the 512 x 512 RGB-D camera image (the real size; the fake returns an 8 x 8 x 3 = 192-value placeholder), the 32-channel lidar scan, the critic height scan and the depth group, the viz_camera_obs and depth_obs groups, and the velocity_commands, joint_pos and joint_vel observation terms. The upstream observation is a dict of six groups (go2_matterport_vision_cfg.py:133-139); the fake represents policy (12 last-action placeholder values), proprio (6 placeholder values) and camera_obs only. The real action space is built by the external ManagerBasedRLEnv from the JointPositionActionCfg over all joints (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:125); the joint count and bounds are not in the clone (the robot is the external USD asset at :70), so the fake publishes an unbounded 12-value Box (the 12 is a placeholder in fake.py) and no bound is invented; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE reports CL2. The fake returns reward 0.0 and never terminates or truncates; the upstream -200.0 termination penalty, the time_out, base-contact and bad-orientation terms and the 200000.0 s episode are not modelled (go2_matterport_base_cfg.py:116-118, :230-245 and :369). There is no R2R/Matterport reset, no rendering and no snapshot/restore; the fake was never compared with an Isaac Sim run. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 (action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close are the Gymnasium interface from the external base), G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE and four G8.NO_UNIT (ticks, both seed inputs and action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no extension ids and no catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (the report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
